Mock X.509 certificate generation and public key extraction for two certificate formats.

# Purpose
This C file defines helper code for a mock X.509 certificate used in tests or other controlled code paths. The `fd_x509_mock_tpl` array stores a fixed DER-encoded certificate template with an Ed25519 public key field at a known offset. The [`fd_x509_mock_cert`](<#fd_x509_mock_cert>) function copies this template into an output buffer and inserts a caller-supplied 32-byte public key at `FD_X509_MOCK_PUBKEY_OFF`, so code can build a certificate with a chosen key while keeping the rest of the certificate data fixed.

The file also provides public-key extraction helpers for two certificate layouts. [`fd_x509_mock_pubkey_v1`](<#fd_x509_mock_pubkey_v1>) searches for an older Agave v1.18 certificate prefix with `memmem` and returns the 32-byte key that follows it. [`fd_x509_mock_pubkey_v2`](<#fd_x509_mock_pubkey_v2>) checks for an exact match against the fixed template and returns the key from the known offset. The public [`fd_x509_mock_pubkey`](<#fd_x509_mock_pubkey>) function tries both formats and returns the key pointer when the certificate matches one of them, or `NULL` when it does not.
